summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model hubs like Hugging Face, which hosts over 3 million public models as of August 2026, and developer-facing inference platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow that make running open models fast and accessible. Download activity is highly concentrated — roughly half of all Hugging Face models have fewer than 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads — and China has overtaken the U.S. in monthly model downloads. These platforms differ primarily in whether they emphasize model storage and distribution, local on-device inference, or hosted serverless inference APIs.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The largest open repository and collaboration hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus hosted inference endpoints for deployment.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million+ public models (crossed 3 million in August 2026; ~747,000 added in first 7.7 months of 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free hosting for public/private repos; Pro at ~$9/month; Inference Endpoints and serverless inference billed by compute/usage; Enterprise plans available
features: Massive model, dataset, and Spaces catalog
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Git-based version control for models and datasets
Download stats, model cards, and community discussions
Spaces for hosting interactive demos
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and teams needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and collaboration tooling

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A tool for running powerful open LLMs locally on your own device with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated open models (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi) across many quantized variants
platforms.pricing: Free and open source for local use; no per-token costs (you supply the hardware)
features: One-command local model download and run
Optimized GGUF/quantized models for consumer hardware
Built-in local REST API compatible with many clients
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Model library with easy pulls and custom Modelfiles
Privacy-friendly offline inference
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally without cloud dependencies

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open and community models via API, with a focus on ease of use for any ML model.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models spanning text, image, audio, and video
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU usage); no subscription required
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Automatic scaling and cold-start management
Wide coverage of image/video/audio generation models
Public model gallery with ready-to-run examples
Fine-tuning support for select models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to deploy or call diverse open models (especially multimodal) via API without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open-source LLMs and multimodal models.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, and others)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); hourly GPU clusters for training; fine-tuning billed by usage
features: Fast serverless inference with OpenAI-compatible API
Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters for training
Fine-tuning and custom model hosting
Broad catalog of leading open models
Competitive token pricing and high throughput
Batch inference and embeddings support
platforms.best_for: Startups and developers building production apps on open LLMs who need scalable, low-cost inference and training

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open and fine-tuned generative AI models with enterprise-grade performance.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, and image models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments; volume/enterprise discounts
features: Highly optimized low-latency inference (FireAttention engine)
OpenAI-compatible API
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model serving
Function calling and JSON mode support
Multimodal and image generation models
Dedicated deployments for predictable performance
platforms.best_for: Teams needing fast, production-grade inference for open models with strong latency and throughput guarantees

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer inference platform offering fast, affordable access to a wide range of open models, with strong coverage of Chinese open-source models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models including DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Llama, and image/audio models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing with competitive rates; free tier/credits for some models
features: OpenAI-compatible serverless inference API
Strong catalog of leading Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and video model support
Low-cost, high-throughput inference
Fine-tuning and dedicated deployment options
Accessible to developers in Asia and globally
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting cost-effective access to top open models, particularly Chinese-origin LLMs and multimodal models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform running open models on custom LPU hardware for extremely fast token generation.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mixtral, DeepSeek distills)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing; free developer tier with rate limits
features: Industry-leading inference speed via custom LPU chips
OpenAI-compatible API
Very high tokens-per-second throughput
Low and predictable latency
Focus on popular open LLMs
Simple developer onboarding
platforms.best_for: Developers building real-time or latency-sensitive applications on open models

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with provider-based rates; small platform margin; free models available
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API for many providers
Automatic routing, fallback, and price/latency optimization
Access to both open and proprietary models
Transparent per-model pricing comparison
Usage analytics and spend controls
Easy provider switching without code changes
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting flexible access to many models and providers through one API with cost and routing control
